newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Girl from Jaffna writes open letter to President Chandrika Kumaratunga appealing for action on disappearance of her 18-year-old sister at army checkpoint.
President Kumaratunga says 1997 budget will not heap burdens on people.
Tamil refugees fast in Denmark to protest against plans to send them back to Sri Lanka.
Supreme Court upholds Appeal Court verdict that government's dissolution of two opposition-ruled provincial councils was illegal.
Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar says no foreign military involved in fight against LTTE.
Troops kill 30 Tamil rebels in clash in Batticaloa on Sunday.
LTTE builds up base in Mannar to house large number of fighters and rebel leaders.
Tamil Tiger rebel chief Velupillai Prabhakaran charged with January 31 Central Bank bombing.
